wholePhysicalScope: The named OpenStreetMap dam shares ten positions with the native reservoir ring. The independent mapped crest road follows the curved crest across both major abutments. The official heritage boundary includes the downstream pool and adjacent bed.
lodDetails: Every detail level retains the complete crest road, twelve openings and gravity wall. Near levels refine arches, concrete siphons, pool and footbridge.
limitations: Road axis and downstream footbridge use independent mapped centerlines. The 5 m survey establishes the crest datum and local valley relief. Individual bay spacing, siphon boxes and local abutment treatments are estimates.

The records describe complete engineering height including foundations. The visible model follows the ground survey for the downstream face and omits buried portions. The 35.95 m HKPD full water elevation anchors the spillway section.
The valve house and memorial stone are separate assets. The basin outline, water level and visible engineering finishes are interpreted from the native terrain and written engineering sources.
